name: Honey Hill Orchard
description: Honey Hill Orchard is a working pumpkin patch in Waterman, IL. It grows Raspberries, Apples, Pumpkins, and Honey, with picking through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
